home.heroTitle: The right tutor. A brighter future.
home.heroSub: Free online educational sessions delivered by verified, qualified volunteers to primary, intermediate, and secondary students — safe, organized, and with measured impact.
home.trust_line: Every volunteer is reviewed and verified before appearing. Guardians can see every session.
home.missionTitle: Together, we create a brighter future
home.missionBody: A Saudi volunteer platform bringing education graduates together to teach students and support their learning journey — because knowledge is giving, and every student deserves support that costs their family nothing.
home.how1_body: Education graduates apply with their background, qualifications, and subjects.
home.how2_body: Our team reviews every application: qualifications, background, and a short interview. Nobody appears before approval.
home.how3_body: Each volunteer is classified by stage, subjects, and teaching style.
home.how4_body: We connect each student's request with the best-fit volunteer — with clear reasons, never internal scores.
home.how5_body: The session happens, feedback is recorded, and volunteer hours are documented in an append-only ledger.
home.volunteerTitle: Make a difference in a student's life.
home.volunteerBody: If you are a graduate or teacher with time and knowledge to give — this is your place. Your hours are documented, your impact is measured, and your student is waiting.
home.volunteerPoint1: Official verification with a “Verified Volunteer” badge.
home.volunteerPoint2: A flexible schedule you set, sessions online.
home.volunteerPoint3: An official hours statement you can rely on.
home.impactEmpty: Numbers will appear as the platform grows. We never display invented figures — every number comes from real sessions recorded in the database.
home.ctaBandBody: Whether you are a student looking for support, or a volunteer with time to give — the platform is open to you.
